subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvam situações de compra e venda e formas de pagamento, utilizando termos como troco e desconto, enfatizando o consumo ético, consciente e responsável.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo cálculo de troco em uma situação de compra e venda
components.description_en: Solve problems involving calculating change in a buying-and-selling situation
components.cc_component_description: Construct simple equations to solve problems

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo cálculo de desconto em uma compra
components.description_en: Solve problems involving calculating a discount on a purchase
components.cc_component_description: Solve problems involving finding the whole when given a part and the percent

components.description_pt: Compor uma situação de problema envolvendo compra, venda ou formas de pagamento
components.description_en: Compose a problem situation involving buying, selling, or forms of payment

components.description_pt: Avaliar escolhas do consumidor em termos de comportamento ético e responsável
components.description_en: Evaluate consumer choices in terms of ethical and responsible behavior

cc_matches.description: Find a percent of a quantity as a rate per 100 (e.g., 30% of a quantity means 30/100 times the quantity); solve problems involving finding the whole, given a part and the percent.
Use variables to represent quantities in a real-world or mathematical problem, and construct simple equations and inequalities to solve problems by reasoning about the quantities.
